title: Mean curvature through an injective parametrization differential
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, y ∈ ℝᴺ, every injective continuous linear map A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ with tangentSpace M y = range A, and every continuous linear S : ℝⁿ → L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) (a bilinear map (a, b) ↦ S a b, not assumed symmetric) such that secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b) for all a, b ∈ ℝⁿ: meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (Σ_{l ∈ Fin n} S e_l (G⁻¹ e_l)), where e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 is the standard basis of ℝⁿ and G⁻¹ := Ring.inverse (A* ∘ A), A* := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (S : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ a b : Rn n, secondFundamentalForm M y (A a) (A b) = normalPart M y (S a b)) → meanCurvature M y = normalPart M y (∑ l : Fin n, S (EuclideanSpace.single l 1) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))
